svg.title: One shared movement-scoring graph policy across heterogeneous traffic networks
svg.desc: Two differently structured OSM-derived traffic networks become LaneGroup and Movement graphs. The same graph neural network scores a variable number of movements. Junction-specific binary phase-incidence matrices sum the movement scores into differently sized phase-logit vectors, after which a runtime availability mask restricts phase selection. A footer shows PPO-rollout cities and Freiburg held out from PPO rollouts, with iteration 85 as the completed endpoint.
svg.text: One shared policy, different networks and phase spaces
Learn priorities for common control primitives—Movements—then map them to each junction’s legal phases
same node and edge types; different graph size
phase logit ℓj,p = Σm Aj,p,m sm · shared θ, local Aj
held out from PPO rollouts; periodic evaluation
